about: uProc answers with a null message and an error text instead of records

reads.note: uProc's process endpoint (n8n's uProc node POSTs {processor: get-domain-records, params: {domain}} with the template's leading space kept in the domain); the result is under message, as the template family reads it (shape assumed: uProc's API docs are no longer published)

branches: no IF/Switch: one lookup, malformed answer
expect.offline: The domain is fixed in Create Domain Item (n8n.io), so the variants differ only in what uProc answers. Nothing is written: the comparison is the uProc node's output items (the run's terminal step). uProc's response wrapper beyond message is assumed.
